items.title: Biogeochemical cycles ke primary reservoirs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the primary reservoirs of biogeochemical cycles, printed page 230.

blocks.text: Primary reservoir ("sink" ya "pool", yaani bara zakheera) biosphere ka woh bohat bara hissa hai jahan kisi biogeochemical cycle ka element lambe arse tak jama rehta hai. Primary reservoir ki bunyad par biogeochemical cycles ki yeh qismein hain:

items: Gaseous cycles: in ka reservoir hawa ya samandar (evaporation ke zariye) hai. Nitrogen cycle, oxygen cycle, carbon cycle aur water cycle gaseous cycles hain.
Sedimentary cycles: in ka reservoir zameen ki oopri parat (Earth’s crust) hai. Phosphorus cycle, sulfur cycle aur calcium cycle waghaira sedimentary cycles hain.

blocks.prompt: Phosphorus cycle gaseous hai ya sedimentary?
blocks.explanation: Sedimentary, kyun ke is ka primary reservoir zameen ki parat (crust) hai, hawa nahin.

items: Primary reservoir: biosphere ka bara hissa jahan element lambe arse tak jama rehta hai.
Gaseous cycles (reservoir hawa ya samandar): nitrogen, oxygen, carbon, water.
Sedimentary cycles (reservoir zameen ki parat): phosphorus, sulfur, calcium.
